title: Fishing Game
description: Reel in a slippery fish by holding its bobbing catch zone right on top of it until the line meter fills up, in this free and relaxing browser game.
about:
Fishing Game turns the most tense moment of fishing into a quick, tactile mini-game. A fish darts up and down inside a tall glass tank next to your rod, and you control a light catch zone that rises while you hold and sinks as soon as you let go.

Keep the fish inside the zone and the meter beside the tank fills up while the reel spins and the line pulls tight. Let it slip away and the meter drains, so every catch is a small battle of rhythm and patience. The zone has weight and bounces off the bottom, which makes gentle, well-timed presses much better than frantic tapping.

When the meter is full you land the fish with a Nice Catch banner. It is a calm, satisfying game for short breaks, easy to learn with a single button.
howToPlay: Hold down the mouse button, your finger or any key to lift the catch zone, and release it to let the zone sink. Keep the fish inside the zone to fill the meter on the right; while the fish is outside, the meter drains. Fill the meter to the top to land the fish, then click or tap the banner to fish again.
tips: Use short, repeated presses to hover the zone instead of holding it down the whole time.
Let go a little before the zone reaches the fish, because it keeps drifting upward for a moment.
When the fish heads to the bottom, simply release and let the zone fall with it.
Stay calm when the meter drops: there is no time limit, so you can always win it back.

faq.question: Is Fishing Game free to play?
faq.answer: Yes. Fishing Game is completely free and runs in your browser with no download or sign-up.

faq.question: Can I play Fishing Game on a phone or tablet?
faq.answer: Yes. Touch and hold anywhere on the screen to raise the catch zone and lift your finger to let it sink.

faq.question: Can I lose a fish?
faq.answer: No. The meter can drain to empty, but the fish never escapes, so you can keep trying until you fill the meter and land it.
